name: Commune With Nature
description:
Casting time: 1 minute.

You briefly commune with the living world to learn of your surroundings. Roll Spirit and divide the result by 5. The total is the number of miles around you that your awareness extends. Choose two:

  • Terrain and bodies of water.

  • Prevalent plants, minerals, animals, and peoples.

  • Powerful deities or spirits.

  • Humanoid-made structures.

You learn the direction, distance, and general nature of the chosen elements within range. This communion grants knowledge, not sensory perception.

Describe your awareness.
successes:
✨: Choose another element from the list.

🌞: Choose one location within your range of awareness. For 5 seconds, you can see or hear (choose one) as if you were in that location.
